page_title: CAG 0-0 EMP | Cagliari v Empoli 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Fabio Maresca has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+5' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Elia Caprile, who tips the ball around the post. The ball is out of play. Cagliari win a corner kick.
90+5' The Cagliari players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
90+3' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi will be replaced by Jakub Jankto (Cagliari).
90+3' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti is replaced by Andrea Petagna (Cagliari).
89' Substitution. Ibrahim Sulemana did his best and is replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari).
89' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) replacing Nicolas Viola.
89' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
86' Empoli are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
84' Viktor Kovalenko will be replaced by Ardian Ismajli (Empoli).

83' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot into the bottom left corner. Elia Caprile anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
82' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
81' The referee blows his whistle as Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) was too aggressive in his challenge. Cagliari have been awarded a penalty kick!
80' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
80' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
79' A player from Empoli commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
78' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.

75' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
73' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to substitute Francesco Caputo and he is replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli).
73' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
72' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
69' Celebrations are cut short for Cagliari as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
68' The Cagliari players halt their celebrations as referee Fabio Maresca makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
66' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up in the roof of the net.
64' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
60' Filippo Ranocchia comes onto the pitch because Simone Bastoni (Empoli) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Daniel Maldini will be replaced by Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli).
59' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) is able to continue to play.
59' The game is interrupted now, Simone Bastoni (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

56' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His header would have probably ended up in the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
56' It seemed like Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
53' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
52' Cagliari take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
50' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
46' The game is over for Youssef Maleh (Empoli). Simone Bastoni comes on for the second half.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a half-time substitution. Zito Luvumbo comes on in place of Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Fabio Maresca has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+8' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
45+6' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post.
45+5' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will take a corner kick.
45+3' No action against Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari), and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Fabio Maresca got that spot on. VAR seen to good effect there!
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

45' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari), but referee Fabio Maresca must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
43' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
41' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
40' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' It seemed like Daniel Maldini (Empoli) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
37' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) leaps to meet the corner from Nicolas Viola, but plants his header a whisker wide of the left post from close range.
36' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

36' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
33' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle as Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
32' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is about to take a corner kick.
29' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
29' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) gets a yellow card.
26' Empoli are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
25' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Alberto Grassi (Empoli).
23' The corner from Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is cleared away by the defence.
23' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
23' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' The game is interrupted now, Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
21' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
19' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
17' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
15' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
14' Daniel Maldini (Empoli) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
13' Daniel Maldini (Empoli) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Francesco Caputo and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
11' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) offside.
9' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
7' The corner from Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is hurriedly cleared.
7' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
5' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
3' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Empoli will kick the game off.
Fabio Maresca is introduced as the referee for today's match.
